model_annotation:
The image presents two line plots. 

The plots share the IWF Fiskalindex on the y-axis, ranging from 0 to 2.5 on the left plot and 0 to 1.5 on the right plot, with intervals of 0.5. 

The x-axis spans from 1995 to 2020, with intervals of 5 years. 

The left plot illustrates the relationship between IWF Fiskalindex and Schuldenquote Gesamtstaat. The blue line starts at approximately 0.1 in 1995 and increases to 1.1 in 2010, then decreases to 0.35 in 2020, with a peak of 1.05 in 2009. The maroon line starts at 0.05 in 1995 and increases to 100 in 2020, with a sharp rise between 2009 and 2020. The blue triangles remain constant at 1.35.

The right plot illustrates the relationship between IWF Fiskalindex and Schuldenquote Zentralstaat. The blue line starts at approximately 0.2 in 1995 and increases to 1.05 in 2010, then decreases to 0.35 in 2020, with a peak of 1.05 in 2010. The maroon line starts at 35 in 1995 and increases to 70 in 2020, with a sharp rise between 2010 and 2020. The blue triangles remain constant at 1.35.
